metadata.title: Lomustine and Bevacizumab 5 mg/kg Therapy
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP and current product sources reconciled with explicit gaps/conflicts. Software evidence does not establish independent clinical approval.

source_conflicts.resolution: Source table does not allocate a dose. Specialist review unless an existing hold still requires recovery to 100.
NCCP ANC >=1 differs from common SmPC WBC >=4. These measures are not interchangeable; reconcile the product and clinical context before restart.
Current common SmPC 70% row includes platelets 24,000-74,999 but 50% row includes <25,000. No automated dose from that overlapping source table.
NCCP 6 months after treatment differs from current common SmPC 7 months for women/4 months for men. Confirm the actual products and combined regimen with pharmacy.
NCCP PFTs are conditional; current common SmPC recommends baseline and ongoing tests. Source-specific planning must remain explicit.
75% of original lomustine dose requires the actual original capped dose and prior reduction history. No automatic multiplication of a nominal 90 mg/m 2 reference.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00742 Version 3. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

treatment.schedule_summary: Bevacizumab 5 mg/kg IV on Days 1,15,29 and lomustine 90 mg/m² orally on Day 1 (maximum 160 mg), every 42 days for up to six cycles.
treatment.duration_text: Up to six 42-day cycles; delays and dose changes depend on the individual plan.

components.note: Initial infusion 90 minutes, then 60 and 30 minutes only if tolerated; rapid infusion requires the separate approved local plan. No bolus.
Single Day 1 oral dose only, not daily. Confirm the actual capped dose, capsule strength and pharmacy supply. Never repeat before six weeks.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only and intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; minimal, local or non-invasive intervention may be indicated; may limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant but not immediately life-threatening; hospital care may be indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event and assess severity, intervention required and functional impact.

recent_major_surgery_or_unhealed_wound.label: Recent major surgery or unhealed wound

hypertension_grade.label: Hypertension grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No treatment-emergent hypertension.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Pre-hypertension range or transient mild elevation; no antihypertensive treatment indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Persistent or recurrent elevation requiring initiation or adjustment of one antihypertensive agent; generally 140–159/90–99 mmHg in adults.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe elevation requiring more than one drug or more intensive treatment; generally at least 160 systolic or 100 diastolic in adults.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences such as hypertensive crisis; urgent intervention required.

hypertension_grade.assessment_guidance: Use repeated, correctly measured blood pressure readings and record whether antihypertensive treatment or urgent intervention is required.

severe_bp_uncontrolled.label: Severe hypertension remains uncontrolled despite medication (legacy >200/110 flag)

fistula_grade.label: Fistula grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No fistula. Use the anatomical site-specific CTCAE fistula term.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Symptomatic; non-invasive intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms; invasive intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

fistula_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the anatomical site-specific CTCAE fistula term; assess symptoms, need for invasive intervention and life-threatening consequences.

thromboembolic_event_grade.label: Thromboembolic event grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No thromboembolic event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Grade 1 is generally not used for clinically confirmed venous or arterial thromboembolism; use the specific CTCAE term.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Medical intervention such as anticoagulation is indicated without urgent instability.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Urgent medical intervention or hospital care is indicated.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening haemodynamic or neurological consequences; urgent intervention required.

thromboembolic_event_grade.assessment_guidance: Confirm the event and assess symptoms, need for anticoagulation or urgent intervention, hospitalisation, haemodynamic or neurological instability.

haemorrhage_grade.label: Haemorrhage grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No bleeding. Select the anatomical site-specific CTCAE haemorrhage term.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild bleeding for which intervention is not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate bleeding requiring medical treatment or minor intervention.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe bleeding requiring transfusion, invasive intervention or hospital care.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening bleeding with urgent intervention required.

haemorrhage_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade using the site-specific CTCAE haemorrhage term, intervention required, transfusion need, hospitalisation and haemodynamic consequences.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP: lomustine oral moderate-to-high risk on Day 1; bevacizumab minimal on each infusion day. Distinct phase/day plans require local pharmacy validation.
other_supportive_care: Monitor blood pressure and urine protein before bevacizumab.
Monitor for delayed lomustine myelosuppression and pulmonary toxicity.
consent_notes: Bevacizumab treatment of glioblastoma is outside the current EMA licensed indications; confirm local consent and governance.
NCCP identifies lomustine as an unlicensed product; coordinate pharmacy supply and consent.
Rapid bevacizumab infusion is a separate off-label administration method requiring local approval and consent.
supportive_care.monitoring: NCCP baseline/regular FBC, renal/liver, urine protein and BP; baseline glucose and conditional PFT/echo/INR. Current lomustine SmPC prefers weekly CBC for at least six weeks after each dose. No fixed MRI interval specified.
supportive_care.contraception: Ask oncology pharmacy to confirm the actual products and all regimen components: NCCP six-month wording differs from the current lomustine common SmPC (women seven months; men four months).
supportive_care.administration_safety: Single Day 1 lomustine dose with at least six weeks between courses. Bevacizumab-only visits do not require another lomustine dose.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: Lomustine Day1 and separate bevacizumab-only support
